parameters.name: K8sClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the data plane cluster. You must specify either this parameter or ServiceMeshId, but not both.

parameters.name: LbType
parameters.description:
The type of the load balancer. Valid values:

- `clb`: Classic Load Balancer

- `nlb`: Network Load Balancer (NLB)

The default value is `clb`.

parameters.name: NetworkType
parameters.description:
The network type. Valid values:

- `intranet`: virtual private cloud (VPC)

- `internet`: Internet

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the ASM instance. You must specify either this parameter or K8sClusterId, but not both.
